segments.name: Overnight air cargo
segments.description: Operates and maintains cargo aircraft flying daily small-package routes for FedEx in the eastern U.S., upper Midwest and Caribbean.
segments.evidence: MAC, CSA, WASI, and Royal comprise the overnight air cargo segment of the Company.

segments.name: Ground support equipment
segments.description: Manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Ground support equipment (formerly known as ground equipment sales), which manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment products to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers

segments.name: Commercial aircraft, engines and parts
segments.description: Manages and leases aviation assets, supplies surplus and aftermarket jet engine components, and provides parts sales, disassembly, procurement and repair services to airlines.
segments.evidence: Contrail, Jet Yard, AirCo, Worthington, Jet Yard Solutions, Air'Zona, and LGSS comprise the commercial aircraft, engines and parts segment of the Company.

segments.name: Digital solutions
segments.description: Develops and provides digital aviation and other business services to aviation industry customers to generate recurring subscription revenues.
segments.evidence: Digital solutions, which develops and provides digital aviation and other business services to customers within the aviation industry to generate recurring subscription revenues

segments.name: Regional airline
segments.evidence: Regional airline, which provides scheduled regional passenger, freight and charter airline services and pilot training in Australia, operating a fleet of Saab 340 aircraft serving regional communities and connecting passengers to major metropolitan centers.

revenueModel.text: Air T earns revenue primarily from FedEx under dry-lease contracts paying monthly rent per aircraft plus reimbursement of operating costs, and from equipment sales, aviation asset services, subscriptions and airline services to other customers.
revenueModel.evidence: These dry-lease agreements provide for the lease of specified aircraft by MAC and CSA in return for the payment of monthly rent with respect to each aircraft leased, for which monthly rent reflects an estimate of a fair market rental rate.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company introduced a new reportable segment named regional airline following its acquisition of Regional Express Holdings Pty Ltd (Rex).
changes.evidence: On December 18, 2025, the Company introduced a new reportable segment named regional airline.

changes.text: The ground equipment sales segment was renamed ground support equipment.
changes.evidence: Ground support equipment (formerly known as ground equipment sales), which manufactures and provides mobile deicers and other specialized equipment products to passenger and cargo airlines, airports, the military and industrial customers

changes.text: The commercial jet engines and parts segment was renamed commercial aircraft, engines and parts.
changes.evidence: Commercial aircraft, engines and parts (formerly known as commercial jet engines and parts), which manages and leases aviation assets; supplies surplus and aftermarket commercial jet engine components; provides commercial aircraft disassembly/part-out services; commercial aircraft parts sales; procurement services and overhaul and repair services to airlines
